class.name: OcgV3dPlane
class.brief_description: Obsolete clip plane presentation class. Ported on new core of Graphic3d_ClipPlane approach. Please access Graphic3d_ClipPlane via ClipPlane() method to use it for standard clipping workflow. Example of use:

method.name: V3d_Plane
method.description: Creates a clipping plane from plane coefficients.

method.name: Display
method.description: Display the plane representation in the chosen view.

method.name: Plane
method.description: Returns the parameters of the plane.

method.name: IsDisplayed
method.description: Returns TRUE when the plane representation is displayed.

method.name: ClipPlane
method.description: Use this method to pass clipping plane implementation for standard clipping workflow.
